name: product-analytics-datasets
title: Datasets used in Product Experimentation and Customer Value Analytics
description: Two public third-party datasets used by the analyses in this repository: the Cookie Cats mobile-game A/B test (90,189 players) and the CDNOW transaction log (69,659 purchases by 23,570 customers, January 1997 to June 1998) with derived customer summaries. The files are unmodified copies; see DATA_DICTIONARY.md.

licenses.name: not-specified
licenses.title: No licence stated by the original owners. Included unmodified for research and education; the datasets remain the property of their original owners. The repository code is MIT-licensed.

resources.name: cookie-cats
resources.title: Cookie Cats A/B test
resources.description: One row per player (90,189 players) randomised to the first progress gate at level 30 (control) or level 40 (treatment), with game rounds and day-1 and day-7 retention.

fields.name: userid
fields.title: Player ID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the player (one row per player).

fields.name: version
fields.title: Experiment arm
fields.description: First progress gate the player was randomly assigned on install: gate_30 (control) or gate_40 (treatment).

fields.name: sum_gamerounds
fields.title: Game rounds played
fields.description: Number of game rounds played by the player during the first 14 days after install (per the original DataCamp description).

fields.name: retention_1
fields.title: Day-1 retention
fields.description: True if the player came back and played 1 day after installing.

fields.name: retention_7
fields.title: Day-7 retention
fields.description: True if the player came back and played 7 days after installing.

sources.title: Cookie Cats: original release for DataCamp's 'Mobile Games A/B Testing with Cookie Cats' project (game by Tactile Entertainment); this copy was taken from a public GitHub mirror.

resources.name: cdnow-master
resources.title: CDNOW transaction log
resources.description: Whitespace-aligned text with a header row: customer_id (zero-padded string), date (YYYYMMDD), number_of_cds (units bought), dollar_value (purchase value in US dollars). 69,659 purchases by 23,570 customers, 1997-01-01 to 1998-06-30.

sources.title: CDNOW: made available by Peter Fader and Bruce Hardie for research use and distributed with the open-source lifetimes package, from which these files were taken.

resources.name: cdnow-sample
resources.title: CDNOW transaction log, 2,357-customer sample
resources.description: Whitespace-aligned text with no header row and five columns: customer_id (as in the master file), sample customer number (1 to 2,357), date (YYYYMMDD), number of CDs, dollar value. 6,919 purchases.

sources.title: CDNOW: made available by Peter Fader and Bruce Hardie for research use and distributed with the open-source lifetimes package, from which these files were taken.

resources.name: cdnow-customers-summary
resources.title: CDNOW recency/frequency summary
resources.description: Recency, frequency and age for each of the 2,357 sample customers over the 39-week calibration period.

fields.name: ID
fields.title: Sample customer number
fields.description: Customer number within the 2,357-customer CDNOW sample (1 to 2,357); matches the second column of CDNOW_sample.txt.

fields.name: frequency
fields.title: Repeat purchases
fields.description: Number of repeat purchases (purchases after the first) in the calibration period.

fields.name: recency
fields.title: Recency (weeks)
fields.description: Weeks between the customer's first and last purchase in the calibration period; 0 when there is no repeat purchase.

fields.name: T
fields.title: Customer age (weeks)
fields.description: Weeks between the customer's first purchase and the end of the calibration period (the first 39 weeks).

sources.title: CDNOW: made available by Peter Fader and Bruce Hardie for research use and distributed with the open-source lifetimes package, from which these files were taken.

resources.name: cdnow-customers-summary-with-transactions
resources.title: CDNOW summary with mean repeat-purchase value
resources.description: As cdnow_customers_summary.csv, plus zbar, the mean value of repeat purchases, for the Gamma-Gamma spend model.

fields.name: x
fields.title: Repeat purchases
fields.description: Number of repeat purchases in the calibration period (same quantity as frequency).

fields.name: t_x
fields.title: Recency (weeks)
fields.description: Weeks between first and last purchase in the calibration period (same quantity as recency).

fields.name: T
fields.title: Customer age (weeks)
fields.description: Weeks between first purchase and the end of the calibration period.

fields.name: zbar
fields.title: Mean repeat-purchase value
fields.description: Mean dollar value of the customer's repeat purchases in the calibration period; 0 when there are none.

sources.title: CDNOW: made available by Peter Fader and Bruce Hardie for research use and distributed with the open-source lifetimes package, from which these files were taken.
